DRIVER DECLARATION
Conﬁrmation of Information and Understanding
I conﬁrm that I have received, read and understood the EuroJobsCenter – International
Professional Truck Driver Information Guide before travelling to Germany.
I understand that this handbook has been prepared to provide clear, honest and
transparent information regarding the recruitment process, employment in Germany
and my professional responsibilities.
By signing this declaration, I conﬁrm the following:
I conﬁrm that:
☐ I have had sufficient time to read this handbook.
☐ I have understood the information provided in this handbook.
☐ I had the opportunity to ask questions before signing this declaration.
☐ My questions have been answered to my satisfaction.
☐ I understand that my employer may carry out a practical driving assessment after my
arrival in Germany.
☐ I understand that my continued employment depends on my professional
qualiﬁcations, my performance and the needs of my employer.
☐ I understand that no recruitment agency or employer can legally guarantee permanent
employment.
☐ I understand that my salary depends on my employment contract, my qualiﬁcations,
my responsibilities and my employer.
☐ I understand that I must always comply with German law, road traffic regulations and
my employment contract.
☐ I understand that obtaining the required professional qualiﬁcations, including the EU
Code 95 Qualiﬁcation and the Driver Card, may be necessary for my employment and
that these qualiﬁcations can generally be obtained after completing the applicable legal
requirements.
☐ I understand that changing employers may be possible after completing the
applicable legal procedures and subject to German law and the decisions of the
competent authorities.
☐ I understand that residence permits, visas and employment authorisations are always
governed by German law and the decisions of the responsible authorities.
☐ I understand that EuroJobsCenter provides information and recruitment services but
cannot inﬂuence or guarantee decisions made by German authorities.
☐ I understand that this handbook is intended to provide general information and does
not replace German law, official government regulations or my individual employment
contract.
☐ I conﬁrm that all information I have provided to EuroJobsCenter is true and complete
to the best of my knowledge.
☐ I understand that providing false or misleading information may have legal or
employment-related consequences.

Declaration
I conﬁrm that I have read this handbook carefully.
I understand both the opportunities and the responsibilities of working as a professional
truck driver in Germany.
I voluntarily sign this declaration and acknowledge that I have received the information
contained in this handbook before travelling to Germany.

Applicant Information
Full Name
Passport Number
Nationality
Current Country of Residence
Telephone Number
E-mail Address
Signature Date
Applicant's Signature

FINAL MESSAGE
Thank you for placing your trust in EuroJobsCenter and our international partner
agencies.
We sincerely appreciate the opportunity to support you on your journey to Germany and
throughout the beginning of your new professional career.
EuroJobsCenter works together with carefully selected international partner agencies
that share our commitment to professionalism, transparency, honesty and high-quality
applicant support. Our common goal is to ensure that every applicant receives reliable
information, fair treatment and professional guidance throughout the recruitment and
immigration process.
We wish you a safe journey, a successful start, and a long, healthy and rewarding
professional career in Germany.
Welcome to Germany – we look forward to being part of your success.
